description: This source file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class responsible for discovering and managing network gateways in a macOS application. It includes related data structures, network discovery logic, service resolution, and filtering mechanisms. The class uses Apple’s Network framework, supports background tasks, and implements discovery fallback strategies.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class that handles network gateway discovery, management, filtering, and fallback strategies.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Represents the result of resolving a network service including TXT record, host, and port.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Performs asynchronous DNS service resolution, conforming to NetServiceDelegate, wrapping Apple's NetService for custom resolution and callbacks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts network browsing for gateways across configured domains.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate fallback discovery for wide-area gateways.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate fallback discovery for Tailscale Serve gateways.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all network discovery activities, cancels tasks, and clears state.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Updates the list of discovered gateways for a specific domain based on current network results.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Combines primary and fallback gateway results, filters local gateways if needed, and updates the main gateways list.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Converts wide-area beacon data into DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Converts Tailscale Serve beacon data into DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Initiates DNS service resolution for a specific gateway if not already resolving.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of TXT record key-value pairs into a GatewayTXT struct.

methods.name: buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string from username, host, and port.

methods.name: isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines if a gateway is local based on hostnames, DNS, display name, and local identity.

methods.name: buildLocalIdentityFast
methods.description: Builds a quick local identity based on hostname and display name.

methods.name: buildLocalIdentitySlow
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive local identity including hostname resolution.
